body: BUG-2395 sketch posted as a spec comment (aida show BUG-2395 --comments). It is tagged architecture, so I stopped before writing code. Part A covers the portable scaffold and hook-template fixes, with one question about ownership granularity for .codex/hooks.json managed-merge. Part B covers the Codex lane identity: managed launches reuse the BUG-2398 transport; unmanaged lanes get a relaunch notice plus a narrowing-only CLI correction that drops a mismatched grant and never exports the lease grant. Please rule on B3 vs diagnostics-only, and on entry-level vs slot-level ownership.
subject: BUG-2395 sketch ready for signoff
